task: Controlled report-preview snapshot and completion-ownership design case
problem: Develop an isolated single-view preview state owner under threaded host assumptions
summary: Fourteen controlled checks passed; adding JSON changed renderer and tests while the coordinator stayed byte-identical. No production UI integration occurred.
reasoning_summary: M1 supplied an identity-at-commit question, not a synchronization mechanism. Current threaded ingress led to a narrow lock and immutable selected-row snapshots; formats remain pure functions.
what_worked: Current, stale, cancelled, duplicate and wrong-instance completions had the declared results in the fixture
The predefined JSON variation changed renderer and tests only
what_failed: A deliberately wrong control allowed old completion to overwrite a newer result
The same wrong control retained mutable caller input
hidden_assumptions: One in-process coordinator per preview view
The caller owns and does not concurrently mutate input during request snapshotting
Latest means coordinator admission order; no HTTP or click ordering is established
Project binding and permission checks remain outside this component
negative_preconditions: Do not transfer object identity across processes or serialization
Do not treat a preview snapshot as a database transaction snapshot
Do not claim cancellation stops an already running thread
Do not use one instance to merge independent views without a new contract
trigger_condition: Designing finite selected-row previews whose asynchronous completion may outlive the current request
repair_action: Confirm the host concurrency model and identity lifetime; keep the acceptance check and state publication together, with expensive rendering outside
verification_method: python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_design_preview_case: 14 controlled checks; negative control and coordinator digest comparison
future_rule: Revisit synchronization and identity if the host, process boundary, independent-view scope or ordering contract changes
reuse_feedback: Experience candidate only. History was manually seeded; no independent task reuse or A/B comparison demonstrates Memory benefit.
scope: Controlled development fixture; not production report preview
lesson: A completion-identity question can transfer between hosts, but synchronization, cancellation and identity lifetime must be established again for the current host.
